text: Five Stars. Really cute on our French doors.

product_metadata.title: NICETOWN Small Door Window Curtain - Rod Pocket Privacy Enhancing Blackout Sidelight Patio Door Curtain Panel with Tie-Back, 25W by 72L inches, Stone Blue, 1 Panel
features: Product Info.: The door curtain package comes with 1 panel. Each panel measuring 25 inches wide by 40 inches long comes with matching adjustable TIEBACK. 2 rod pockets (diameter: 1" each) on both top and bottom sides give the curtain a nice fit.

Nice Function: These french door curtains are made of triple weave blackout material, which can block 85%-95% of harmful lights and UV rays out. By a special weaving way, the curtain prevents hot air in summer and cold wind in winter from entering the room.

Stylish & Privacy: Designed for sidelight glass / glazed doors. Pure color is suitable for most home decoration styles. Adjustable tie backs can flexibly control the light enter into the room, you can tie up for decorating room or full shade for keeping privacy.

Hassle-Free: All the door panels are thread trimmed and pre-ironed. You can easily install them right out of the package with your sash rods. Double - rod pockets at both ends provide a variety of options for hanging your door curtain.

Easy Care: NICETOWN blackout curtains are made to last. Machine washable in normal temperature water, use mild detergent, no bleaching, tumble or natural dry. Steam ironing can easily remove wrinkles or any fold marks.
